title: AIFinLab
summary: AIFinLab is a personal research codebase that generates and evaluates synthetic tabular and sequential data for finance-related datasets (e.g., sector/industry fields) using several generative model families. Its test and example scripts directly call SDV's single-table and sequential synthesizers (CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, CopulaGANSynthesizer, PARSynthesizer) along with SDV's metadata schema and evaluation utilities (evaluate_quality, run_diagnostic), using rdt transformers and sdmetrics reports directly, while a vendored copy of the standalone CTGAN package is kept under _baselines/ as a comparison baseline.
